testCase.name: [dev] S15 Cross-patient and cross-context: each chart lists only its own transcripts, and the next chart opens collapsed

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S15 「串病人和串上下文：每个病历只列它自己的转写，下一个病历打开时是收起的」 Cross-patient and cross-context: each chart lists only its own transcripts, and the next chart opens collapsed

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 4；TFA-92594 How it works 4）
  • U5 The expanded transcript is correctly attributed: each line shows the right speaker (Physician / Patient), and the transcript sits under the right patient and visit.（UAT TC-16）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both.（UAT 3.3；TFA-92594 AC 2）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given {hospitalPatient} with the S05 seed, {hospitalPatient2} with one '(prior)' row of its own, {snfResident} with the S06 seed

When Open patient A's '(prior)' row; go back to the list and open patient B; open B's row; switch to Nursing Home and open the resident; open the later visit

Then A shows only A's lines. B arrives collapsed (A's open state not carried over) and shows only B's lines. The resident shows only the resident's visits

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs. cp1 mustContain QA16-H-Y1 and mustNotContain 'QA16-H2-', 'QA16-N-'. cp2 (B arrive) mustContain {hospitalPatient2}, '(prior)' and mustNotContain 'QA16-H-', 'QA16-H2-Y1'. cp3 mustContain QA16-H2-Y1, QA16-H2-Y2 and mustNotContain 'QA16-H-'. cp4 mustContain QA16-N-V2 and mustNotContain 'QA16-H-', 'QA16-H2-' (U4, U5, U8)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U20；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S15
